login.title: Operator sign-in
login.subtitle: Instance administration. Sign in with email, password and TOTP code.
login.codeHint: Six-digit code from your authenticator app. Leave empty on the first sign-in.
login.totpSetupBody: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example FreeOTP or Google Authenticator), then confirm the six-digit code. From then on, signing in as an operator requires the code.
login.codeBody: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
login.invalidCredentials: Sign-in failed. Please check the email address, password and code.
login.invalidCode: The code is not right. Please enter the current code from the authenticator app.
login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait about a minute and try again.
login.sessionRevokedNotice: Your session was ended for security reasons. Please sign in again.
login.forbiddenBody: This account has no operator rights on this instance. To sign in as a member of an organization, use the regular sign-in.
login.sessionExpiredNotice: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.accountDisabled: This operator account is disabled. Signing in is not possible.
login.serverError: The sign-in could not be checked just now. Please try again in a moment.
login.noAnswer: The server does not answer, so the sign-in could not be checked. Please check the connection and try again.
login.setupCannotFinish: The set-up cannot be finished in this step. Please reload the page and sign in again.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.loadError: The organizations could not be loaded.
organizations.createSuccess: Organization “{{name}}” was created; the invitation for its administration is on its way by email.
organizations.archiveMessage: {{name}} will be archived: its members can no longer sign in, and its runs leave the public overview. The data stays and can be restored.
organizations.archiveActiveRuns_one: {{count}} run is active right now. Archiving locks out its coordination and its participants at once. The run itself is not ended.
organizations.archiveActiveRuns_other: {{count}} runs are active right now. Archiving locks out their coordination and their participants at once. The runs themselves are not ended.
organizations.restoreMessage: {{name}} will be restored: sign-in, sessions and public runs return.
organizations.deleteSuccess: The deletion of “{{name}}” is scheduled for {{date}}.
organizations.inviteSuccess: The invitation for {{email}} is on its way by email.
organizations.cancelDeletionMessage: The scheduled deletion of {{name}} is cancelled, and the organization is restored: sign-in, sessions and public runs return.

create.title: Create a new organization
create.intro: Creates the organization and sends its first administrator an invitation by email.
create.slugHelper: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The slug appears in the URLs.
create.slugInvalid: The slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
create.languagesHelper: The first language is the language of the invitation email.
create.emailLabel: Email address of the first administrator

edit.title: Edit organization
edit.languagesHelper: The first language is the language of the invitation email.

delete.title: Schedule the deletion of the organization?
delete.message: After 30 days, every rally, run, account and medium of {{name}} is permanently removed. Restoring it before then cancels the deletion.

invite.title: Invite administrator
invite.intro: Sends an invitation to join {{name}} as its administrator.
invite.replaceHelp: The chosen accounts are deactivated once the invitation is accepted. Without a choice all accounts stay active.
invite.replaceNone: This organization has no admin yet.

legal.title: Legal texts
legal.intro: Legal texts for the whole instance. They apply to every organization that has not set its own texts.

backup.title: Backups
backup.intro: For how many days can a backup of this installation still hold data that the app has already deleted? Enter the value your backup job really keeps, that is the age of the oldest backup. The app changes no backup. The template for the privacy policy and the retention periods of the organizations state this value.
backup.stated: Stated by you. Save it empty to go back to the default.
backup.notStated: Not stated yet. This is the default of the installation (BACKUP_ROTATION_DAYS). The template writes it as an open placeholder until you save a value.

errors.passwordPolicy: The password must be at least 8 characters long and contain three of: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, special characters.
errors.INSTANCE_PASSWORD_REUSE_NOT_ALLOWED: The new password must not match the current or the last password.

errors.EMAIL_HAS_PENDING_INVITATION: An open invitation already exists for this email address.
errors.EMAIL_HAS_ACCOUNT: This email address already belongs to an account, so an invitation to it cannot be accepted. Please use another address.
errors.ORG_NAME_BLANK: The name must not be blank.
errors.ORG_LANGUAGES_EMPTY: At least one language is required.
errors.ORG_NOT_ARCHIVED: Only an archived organization can be deleted.
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The entered slug does not match the organization's slug.
errors.TOTP_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: Two-factor protection is already set up. Please sign in with password and code.
errors.generic: The action failed. Please try again.
errors.REPLACE_NOT_ORG_ADMIN: Only current admins of this organization can be replaced.
